claude.rationale: For p4 (product/process interface), the slice documents no product-line/operations incoherence for the acquired imagery business over time: Earth Intelligence revenue and Adjusted EBITDA were essentially flat 2018-2020 and its goodwill was judged to exceed carrying value with no new impairment in 2019-2020, so no realized product/process disruption is documented. For p5 (process/organization interface), the filing notes 2018-2019 restructuring/headcount reductions and declining transaction/integration expenses, but nothing specifically documenting operations fracturing against people/management/culture in the acquired business; the divestiture in 2020 was of the acquirer's own original MDA space-robotics unit, not the acquired DigitalGlobe imagery business, which was retained. Absent documented evidence of either interface disruption, both are coded 0. The 2018 consolidated loss, $159m combined goodwill write-down, and WorldView-4 satellite-capability loss are disclosed as pre-window comparative context and are not attributed to a product/process or process/organization integration fracture.
